likelihood_policy.data_covariance_selection: must match G5 manifest hashes exactly
likelihood_policy.Pantheon_M_B: analytically profiled; equivalent cosmological posterior to marginalization under a common flat nuisance measure; common evidence normalization cancels only in LCDM-vs-RLL Bayes-factor differences
likelihood_policy.absolute_logZ_boundary: report sampler logZ and error, but interpret lnB10 differences rather than absolute evidence normalization

mcmc.initialization: independent Gaussian clouds around the G4 best fit with sigma=0.02 of each prior width; clipped strictly inside bounds
mcmc.note: walkers are pooled within each independently seeded ensemble for between-ensemble Rhat; this is a limited convergence diagnostic, while global mode discovery is cross-checked separately by nested sampling

prior_sensitivity.rule: report delta lnB10 relative to base prior; do not select prior by which model wins

reconciliation.rule: historical outputs are comparison evidence only because their datasets/calibrations/priors differ from G5
reconciliation.bic_proxy: compare sign and scale qualitatively; BIC is not Bayes evidence

pass_when: G5 manifest hashes match local executor/contracts/input hashes
all MCMC ensembles produce finite posterior samples and max split-Rhat <= 1.10
three nested seeds per model return finite logZ and logZerr
lnB10 span across nested seed pairs <= 1.0
prior sensitivity is reported rather than hidden
posterior contact with Omega_s0=0 is explicitly recorded
negative lnB10 is preserved if observed
stop_when: nonconverged MCMC is used for claims
prior variant is chosen post-hoc by preferred conclusion
boundary: G6_PASS_LIMITED_CANONICAL_INFERENCE != independent replication != perturbation closure != physical confirmation
